Phrases: Thunder take me. Time to dry my bloody gear again.
The sky has decided to piss on me again.
Thor, for fuck's sake, leave the sky alone!
Odin's watching with his one good eye and laughing at this shit.
Soaked to the bone. Great, now I have to dry off again. Fuck.
The rain will stop. This soggy crap I'm wearing? Who knows.
Wet clothes, miserable mood. Lovely.
Njord, thanks for the shower. Less ice water next time?
Cold to the bone. Where's my fucking campfire?
Can't feel my fingers. Can definitely feel my arse freezing.
Feels like Hel herself is blowing cold air up my armour.
A bit longer and you can use me as a block of ice.
By Odin's one eye, this fog is thicker than a troll's skull.
Can't see shit. And it's not even night.
Did Nidhogg fart? Where the hell is north?
Fog so bloody thick, Odin couldn't find his own missing eye.
Wind in my face, full speed ahead! Try stopping me, Njord!
Sail's up, spirits high. Off to adventure and whatever the fuck comes next.
Ship's moving, crew's swearing. Just as Odin intended.
Onward to glory, frostbite and another disaster at sea.
If we hit the shore, I'll say it was all part of the bloody plan.
Time to kick some arse. Just the waves' arse for now.
Hooray. Another thrilling voyage of doing fuck all.
I'm on the ship. No getting off until we sink, apparently.
Deck underfoot, wind in my face. Beats sitting around camp.
I'm fucking Legolas. They forgot to give me the ears, though.
Bow in hand. Someone's about to regret a lot of things.
Quiet, bastards. The archer's on the hunt.
Bow drawn, brain off. Perfect plan.
Enough shooting. This quiver doesn't shit arrows.
Out of arrows. Officially an unlicensed archer now.
Empty quiver. Completely fucked.
Odin, send arrows. Keep the bloody wisdom.
Time for a bloody mess.
Steel's out. First come, first fucking buried.
Right, enough talking. Let's get to the dismemberment.
Weapon in hand, brain on holiday.
Cooking up some fucking porridge.
Mmm. Dad's soup.
No idea what's in this pot, but it smells bloody good.
Conjuring dinner like proper kitchen berserkers.
If this isn't soup, Odin can take me now.
Fire's up. Let's make something fucking edible.
Pot's boiling, ingredients haven't escaped. Barbarian cooking begins.
Cooking grub. The Aesir can choke on their ambrosia.
Let's cook. If it turns out shit, we'll call it Nordic cuisine.
Done. Looks edible. That's a fucking win already.
Pot's finished. Bring bowls before this crap gets cold.
Dinner's ready. Odin, you try it first. Unless you're scared.
Cooked, served, nothing exploded. Kitchen success.
Yum.
Crunch.
Mmm. Tastes like shit.
Tasty. Fucking lovely.
Ate it without choking. Odin approves.
AAAAH, a fucking {enemy}!
Get this {enemy} away from me!
Odin, if you're watching, deal with this {enemy} yourself.
Well, shit. {enemy} thinks I'm on the menu tonight.
I fucking hate portals.
That magic hole again. Can't we just bloody walk?
Forgive me, Freya. I'm climbing into that glowing shit again.
One blink and we're across the world. Damn convenient.
The Swamp. Even the air's unpleasant here.
Mud, fog and corpses. Lovely place for a stroll.
Welcome to this green fucking nightmare.
Who said Vikings love adventure? I want to go home.
The Plains. Beautiful, quiet... until the mosquito shows up.
See anything flying and horrible? Just bloody run.
Too quiet. Something nasty's about to crawl out of the grass.
Even the grass looks like it wants to kill me.
The Mountains. Fresh air, frozen arse.
Came for silver. Found cold and suffering.
If I freeze to death, drag me somewhere warm.
Odin, why'd you build a world with this much bloody snow?
Fog, ticks and fuck knows what else. Lovely.
Can't see shit, but something's already watching me.
The Mistlands. Even Odin would get lost here.
Looks like someone forgot to finish building this place.
Fucking mosquito! It's the size of a spear!
Who gave that flying bastard wings?
That's no mosquito. That's death with a stinger.
Odin, get this winged fucking thing away from me!
Raid! Who forgot to close the bloody gate?
Enemies at the walls and I haven't even had dinner.
Odin, cover the base before we all shit ourselves.
Well, there goes the quiet life.
So that's {boss}? Looks like a big fucking problem.
Right. This chat with {boss} will be short and bloody.
Odin, if you're watching, now's a great time to help.
Anyone remember why we summoned this thing?
Odin, if that was a test, I failed.
Valhalla can wait. I haven't finished stealing things.
I got killed. Let's keep that between us, fuck's sake.
At least now I know exactly what not to do.
Hel spat me out. Even she got sick of me.
Alive again. Who forgot to finish me off properly?
The hero returns. No gear, face still wrecked.
Right. Where's my corpse, and why is it so bloody far away?
I'm not a Viking. I'm a bloody warehouse with legs.
Why am I carrying this many rocks? Because I'm an idiot.
One more item and I'll count as furniture.
Maybe picking up every last stick was a bad idea.
One more hit and I'm filing a complaint with Odin in person.
I've got less health than that troll has brains.
Stay calm. Try not to die of your own stupidity.
Need healing. Heroism's about to run out.
Weapon's broken. Time to stare the bastards to death.
Sword fell apart. Enemies are still alive, somehow.
Out of steel. Out of patience.
Should've brought a spare instead of trusting in miracles.
Superhero landing. Knees are fucked.
Didn't fall. Just tested the ground's durability.
Next time I'll use the bloody stairs.
Perfect landing. My legs seem to disagree.
Fish caught. The sea won't be happy about this.
Got you, you scaly bastard.
Now we're getting some proper food.
Njord, thanks for dinner. No strings attached this time.
Tree defeated. The forest will remember this.
Another giant falls to my axe.
Tree down. Nature loses again.
That's how you build civilisation. One bloody trunk at a time.
Tamed {creature}. Another mouth to bloody feed.
Welcome to the family, {creature}. Don't touch my stuff.
Another soul in my care. Why did I do this?
My beast now. Touch it and you answer to me.
Rested up. Almost useful again.
Fire, a roof and food. Now that's luxury.
Energy's back. Time to fuck everything up again.
Right. Ready to go and make some new mistakes.
Rest's over. Back to suffering.
Buff's gone. Just a tired bloody Viking again.
Who turned off the comfort? I was just starting to enjoy life.
Out of energy. Somehow the adventures keep coming.
Done. Not perfect, but it didn't explode.
Made it. Hammer's intact. Good day.
There we go. Hope this thing's actually useful.
Done. Now I can pretend it all went to plan.
Finally, a roof. The rain can fuck right off.
Home sweet home. At least nothing kills me immediately here.
Under a roof. Officially no longer a soggy idiot.
Humanity's greatest invention? A decent bloody door.
Harvested {plant}. The land owes me again.
{plant} is ripe. Now that's a proper victory.
The soil gave me {plant}. I still want meat.
Harvest's in. Time to go back to growing absolutely nothing.
Picked {plant}. Nature's delivering dinner now.
Another {plant} on its way to my stomach.
Found {plant}. Hope it's not some poisonous green shit.
Forest shared its supplies. It's on our side today.
